name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: In Darkshire, the search for Stalvan Mistmantle brings a bloodstained journal page before the Night Watch. Commander Althea Ebonlocke sends you to Clerk Daltry to compare its writing with the town records.

sections.title: Closing the Net
sections.body: The Night Watch has gathered journal pages from across Duskwood and the surrounding human territories. Together, they appear to condemn Stalvan Mistmantle, the elusive tutor. Commander Althea Ebonlocke has suspected him for some time, but she needs certainty before passing judgment. The bloodstained page alone cannot prove who wrote it. The writing must be matched to Stalvan’s own hand.

sections.title: The Clerk's Eye
sections.body: Clerk Daltry keeps Darkshire’s town records and has examined countless ledgers and signatures over the years. You bring him the newly discovered journal page to compare with Stalvan’s signatures in the registry. His judgment can settle whether the page is truly Stalvan’s and give the Night Watch the certainty it needs.

faq.q: Why does Commander Ebonlocke need Clerk Daltry's confirmation?
faq.answer: Commander Althea Ebonlocke needs Clerk Daltry to verify whether the bloodstained page matches Stalvan’s handwriting in Darkshire’s records. Daltry maintains the town registry and has long experience examining signatures, so his confirmation can establish Stalvan’s guilt beyond doubt before Ebonlocke takes final action.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into the Legend of Stalvan storyline?
faq.answer: This is the eleventh chapter of the investigation, following the recovery of the bloodstained journal page. Daltry’s comparison is the final check of the evidence before the Night Watch takes decisive steps against Stalvan.

faq.q: Where is Clerk Daltry located in Darkshire?
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry is inside Darkshire’s town hall, where he manages the community’s local records and property registries.

faq.q: What evidence did the investigator bring to Darkshire?
faq.answer: You bring a bloodstained journal page recovered during the search for Stalvan. It describes his grim thoughts and experiences, but its writing still needs to be checked against official records.

faq.q: Does Clerk Daltry confirm the handwriting is Stalvan's?
faq.answer: Yes. Daltry compares the bloodstained page with signatures in the town registry and confirms that the writing matches Stalvan’s, giving Ebonlocke the certainty she sought before acting.

faq.q: Why is the Night Watch so cautious about accusing Stalvan?
faq.answer: The Night Watch wants concrete, verifiable proof before accusing a former scholar of horrific crimes. Even in Duskwood’s troubled, isolated forest, it strives to uphold lawful order rather than rely on rumor or conjecture.

angles.text: Darkshire’s investigation shows how frontier towns maintain law, order, and civil records while undead and shadowed beasts besiege them.
As a human of the southern kingdoms, you can see the tragedies linking Stormwind nobility, Duskwood settlers, and Elwynn’s scattered manors.
